message.reasoning_content:
We need classify relation between two manifestations by same actor in two parliamentary events, blinded. Need determine if both respond to same specific proposition with same/opposite stance, or incomparable etc. Need only text. Need output JSON strict.

We need analyze carefully. Manifestation A: Event public hearing 2022-05-12 theme: Reajustes nas tarifas de energia elétrica devido ao represamento durante pandemia e escassez hídrica. Speaker closing as chair? Talks about problem serious, energy tariffs, need solution, povo cannot pay, transition, clean energy, hydro as reserve, remove encalços from account, multa pecúnia, etc. Manifestation B: 2024-04-16 theme: Participação da Câmara na definição das regras de renovação das concessões das distribuidoras de energia elétrica. Speaker says current concession model needs modified, complaints, tariff social responsibility of União, subsidies, transition, supports PLs 444/445/446.

We need classify relation. Need identify "proposição específica" in each. The categories: STANCE_MAINTAINED/REVERSED require both respond to same specific proposition with same/opposite stance. INCOMPARABLE: positions determinable but not same specific proposition. RELATION_UNCERTAIN if steps not clear. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if at least one no determinable position on any specific proposition.

We need decide. The two events/themes are different: A about tariff increases due to represamento pandemic/drought; B about rules for renewal of distribution concessions. Both energy sector, but specific propositions differ. However maybe both respond to same proposition? Need infer from text. A: maybe responding to "reajuste tarifário" / energy bills. B: responding to "renovação das concessões das distribuidoras" / PLs 444/445/446. Not same proposition. Both have determinable positions: A against high tariffs/for reducing costs, for clean transition, against "encalços" in account, against false intermittency discourse, for ANEEL answer, etc. B for modifying current concession model, for PLs 444/445/446, for tariff social by União, etc. But not same specific proposition. So likely INCOMPARABLE.

Need be careful: Could both respond to same proposition "energy tariff increases/reajustes" because B mentions tariff social, concession model, etc. But event B theme is renewal concessions, not tariff reajustes. The task says "mesma proposição específica" not same broad theme. Need not use external knowledge. A doesn't mention concession renewal. B doesn't mention represamento/pandemic/drought tariff reajustes. So INCOMPARABLE.

Need ensure both have position determinável on specific proposition. A: yes, against burdening consumers with high energy bills, for removing costs from account, for solution to reajuste. B: yes, for modifying concession model and prioritizing PLs 444/445/446. So INCOMPARABLE.

Need output JSON with relation and reasoning. No extra text. Need exactly keys. Use one or two sentences. Ensure relation value exactly one. Could be "INCOMPARABLE". Reasoning: "As duas falas têm posições determináveis, mas tratam de proposições distintas: A foca nos reajustes tarifários e custos repassados à conta; B foca na reforma do modelo de concessões/distribuição e nos PLs 444-446. Não há mesma proposição específica para comparar stance." Good.

Need final only JSON.
